title: DS-CORE delivery plan: components, epics, stories, tasks and evals
summary: Plans all 49 approved requirements: 5 components, 11 epics, 36 stories with 57 evals covering every acceptance criterion, and 48 typed tasks (design, code, deployment, monitoring) with next actions.
rationale: Requirements REQ-0001..REQ-0049 approved by the PO on 2026-10-06; /reqforge:plan requested.

data.title: DS-CORE server
data.description: Rust server: RocksDB storage, Raft, transactions, GQL engine, security, telemetry.

data.title: Bulk importer
data.description: Rust bulk import CLI for CSV/JSONL, Neo4j and MongoDB exports.

data.title: Kubernetes operator
data.description: Kubernetes operator managing DS-CORE clusters (language assumed Go; outside REQ-0048).

data.title: Client drivers
data.description: Official drivers: Java, Python, Go, JS/TS, Rust, C#/.NET, plus shared conformance suite.

data.title: Test harness
data.description: Jepsen-style fault injection, YCSB/CH-style performance and synthetic probe harness.

data.title: Storage, sharding and Raft replication
data.description: Range-partitioned ordered keyspace on RocksDB, replicated per range with Raft.

data.title: Transactions and isolation
data.description: Serializable cross-shard transactions with a safe retry and error contract.

data.title: Graph data model
data.description: Nodes, edges, typed nested properties, bidirectional adjacency, limits and supernodes.

data.title: GQL engine and client protocol
data.description: GQL parser/executor, protocol, delete semantics, indexes and OLTP latency.

data.title: HTAP analytics replicas
data.description: Non-voting analytics replicas, routing, consistency contract and workload isolation.

data.title: Durability, recovery and availability
data.description: PITR, erasure, rolling upgrades and the regional availability SLO.

data.title: Security and compliance
data.description: TLS/mTLS, authentication, RBAC, encryption at rest, audit, SOC 2/ISO 27001 evidence.

data.title: Operations and platforms
data.description: Telemetry, amd64/arm64 builds and the Kubernetes operator.

data.title: Client drivers
data.description: Six official drivers held to one conformance suite.

data.title: Bulk import
data.description: High-throughput, resumable import from CSV/JSONL, Neo4j and MongoDB.

data.title: Engineering constraints
data.description: Rust toolchain, unsafe policy and native-library allow-list enforced in CI.

data.title: Raft group per range with AZ-aware placement and durable commit
data.narrative: As an operator, I want every range replicated by a Raft group across AZs with fsync-before-ack so that acknowledged writes survive node and power loss.

evals.name: power-loss durability and learner quorum exclusion

data.title: Joint-consensus membership change and learner promotion
data.narrative: As an operator, I want to add and remove replicas safely so that a range never has two leaders in one term.

evals.name: jepsen membership churn
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload membership --duration 1h --check single-leader,learner-promotion

data.title: Leader failover within 10 s
data.narrative: As an application owner, I want a failed leader replaced quickly so that writes resume within 10 seconds.

data.title: Automatic range split and replica rebalancing
data.narrative: As an operator, I want ranges to split and rebalance automatically so that the cluster scales out without client errors.

evals.name: add-node rebalance under YCSB A
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- scenario add-node --workload ycsb-a --assert-balance 0.10 --within 1h --assert-zero-errors

evals.name: jepsen continuous splits
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload splits --duration 1h --check serializable

data.title: Serializable cross-shard transaction protocol
data.narrative: As a developer, I want multi-node, multi-shard transactions that are atomic and serializable so that graph updates are never partially applied.

evals.name: jepsen serializability (Elle)
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload list-append --nemesis partition,crash,clock,membership,split --duration 1h --check serializable

data.title: Safe internal retry and retryable conflict error
data.narrative: As a developer, I want conflicts surfaced as a distinct retryable error and never silently retried unsafely so that I can retry correctly.

evals.name: jepsen with internal retry
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload register --internal-retry on --duration 1h --check lost-update

data.title: Node and edge key layout with bidirectional adjacency
data.narrative: As a developer, I want nodes and edges stored with both adjacency directions under each node's key prefix so that traversals are local and consistent.

evals.name: jepsen one-sided edge check
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload edges --duration 1h --check bidirectional

data.title: Typed nested property values, validation and size limit
data.narrative: As a developer, I want typed nested properties with precise numbers, duplicate-key rejection, schemaless labels and a size limit so that data round-trips safely.

evals.name: typed values, duplicates, schemaless
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test graph_model -- typed_values duplicate_keys schemaless

evals.name: property size limit and live reconfiguration

data.title: Supernode adjacency splitting
data.narrative: As a developer, I want hub nodes with millions of edges to keep accepting writes and serve bounded traversals.

data.title: GQL parser, planner and conformance matrix
data.narrative: As a developer, I want a GQL front end with a published conformance matrix so that I know exactly which GQL features work.

data.title: Versioned client protocol with transaction control
data.narrative: As a driver author, I want a documented, versioned protocol so that drivers can submit GQL and control transactions.

evals.name: protocol contract tests
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test protocol -- version_negotiation txn_control

data.title: GQL executor: point lookups and shard-local one-hop traversal
data.narrative: As an application owner, I want identifier lookups and one-hop traversals to hit one key or one range so that OLTP latency targets are met.

data.title: DELETE and DETACH DELETE semantics
data.narrative: As a developer, I want deletes of connected nodes rejected unless detached atomically so that no edge ever dangles.

evals.name: delete semantics across shards
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test gql_delete -- reject_connected detach_atomic

data.title: Transactional property indexes with online build
data.narrative: As a developer, I want label/property indexes maintained in-transaction and built online so that indexed reads are correct and builds don't block traffic.

evals.name: index consistency and uniqueness
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test index -- read_your_commit unique_cross_shard cancel_build

data.title: Analytics learner replicas, routing and consistency contract
data.narrative: As an analyst, I want analytical queries routed only to analytics replicas with replication positions reported so that OLTP is protected and staleness is visible.

evals.name: analytical routing and no fallback
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test htap -- routing_analytics_only no_voter_fallback

data.title: HTAP isolation benchmark
data.narrative: As an application owner, I want proof that analytics load doesn't degrade OLTP p99 by more than 10%.

evals.name: OLTP p99 under analytics saturation
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- htap --oltp ycsb-a --analytics multihop --analytics-cpu 1.0 --assert-p99-degradation 0.10

data.title: Continuous log backup and point-in-time recovery
data.narrative: As an operator, I want to restore to any timestamp in the last 7 days losing at most 5 minutes so that operator error and corruption are recoverable.

data.title: Bounded erasure with crypto-shredding
data.narrative: As a data protection officer, I want deleted data unrecoverable everywhere within 30 days so that erasure requests are honoured.

evals.name: byte-scan after compaction and key destruction

data.title: Rolling upgrade with leader eviction
data.narrative: As an operator, I want to upgrade node by node without downtime.

evals.name: rolling upgrade under load
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- upgrade rolling --from prev-minor --workload ycsb-a --assert-no-failed-interval --assert-p99-factor 1.5

evals.name: mixed-version transaction suite
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- upgrade mixed-version --suite txn

data.title: Availability probe, SLO dashboard and AZ-loss drill
data.narrative: As an SRE, I want availability measured continuously and AZ loss rehearsed so that the 99.99% SLO is evidenced.

data.title: TLS for clients and mTLS between nodes
data.narrative: As a security officer, I want all traffic encrypted and peers mutually authenticated.

data.title: Authentication: SCRAM-SHA-256, x.509, OIDC; secure defaults
data.narrative: As a security officer, I want authentication on by default with three mechanisms so that no anonymous access is possible.

evals.name: secure defaults and auth mechanisms
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test security -- default_deny_loopback scram x509 oidc

data.title: Graph-scoped role-based access control
data.narrative: As an administrator, I want least-privilege roles scoped per graph.

evals.name: RBAC enforcement and documented roles
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test security -- rbac_graph_scope builtin_roles_documented

data.title: Encryption at rest with KMS-wrapped data keys
data.narrative: As a security officer, I want data files, WAL, backups and analytics replicas encrypted with rotatable KMS keys.

evals.name: plaintext marker scan and key rotation

data.title: Append-only redacted audit log with external export
data.narrative: As an auditor, I want authentication, authorization, index and admin events logged without property values.

evals.name: audit coverage, latency and redaction
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test audit -- event_coverage_5s no_property_values

data.title: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 control matrix
data.narrative: As a compliance lead, I want every in-scope control mapped to a requirement or a documented exclusion.

data.title: OpenTelemetry metrics and traces
data.narrative: As an SRE, I want latency, commit, fsync, abort, leader-change and analytics-lag metrics exported every 15 s.

evals.name: OTel collector receives all metrics
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test telemetry -- otel_metrics_15s analytics_lag_units

data.title: linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 builds and CI matrix
data.narrative: As a release manager, I want binaries and the full suite on both architectures, including mixed clusters.

evals.name: full suite on amd64 and arm64

data.title: Kubernetes operator: create, scale, upgrade
data.narrative: As a platform engineer, I want to declare a DS-CORE cluster in Kubernetes and have it ready, scaled and upgraded automatically.

evals.name: cluster lifecycle on 3 K8s versions
evals.command: make -C operator e2e K8S_VERSIONS=latest3 TESTS='TestCreateReady10m TestScale3to5 TestRollingUpgrade'

data.title: Shared driver conformance suite
data.narrative: As a driver maintainer, I want one language-neutral conformance suite run against current and previous server versions.

data.title: Six official drivers: Java, Python, Go, JS/TS, Rust, C#/.NET
data.narrative: As a developer, I want an official driver in my language published with every server release.

data.title: Importer core: parallel loader, reject file, resume
data.narrative: As a migrating customer, I want to load hundreds of millions of elements quickly, see rejects and resume after failure.

evals.name: reject file and resume
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-importer --test import -- reject_file resume_no_duplicates

data.title: CSV and JSON Lines import mapping
data.narrative: As a migrating customer, I want to import generic node and edge files with a documented mapping.

data.title: Neo4j Cypher-script and GraphML import
data.narrative: As a Neo4j user, I want to move my graph to DS-CORE with labels, types, direction and properties intact.

evals.name: Neo4j export fidelity and type mapping
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-importer --test neo4j -- cypher_export graphml_export type_mapping

data.title: MongoDB BSON/Extended JSON import with reference-to-edge mapping
data.narrative: As a MongoDB user, I want documents imported as nodes and chosen reference fields turned into edges.

evals.name: Mongo export fidelity and edge mapping
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-importer --test mongo -- bson_extjson_types reference_edges

data.title: Rust toolchain, unsafe policy and native allow-list gates
data.narrative: As a tech lead, I want CI to enforce Rust-only first-party code, documented unsafe and an approved native-library list.

evals.name: native allow-list
evals.command: cargo deny check && scripts/ci/ffi-allowlist.sh deny.native.toml --require owner,purpose,licence,version,reviewed

data.title: Set up Rust workspace and CI skeleton
data.done_when: cargo build --workspace passes in CI with pinned toolchain; dscore-server, dscore-importer, dscore-harness crates exist.
data.next_action: Create Cargo.toml workspace with crates server/, importer/, harness/ and rust-toolchain.toml pinning stable.

data.title: Add rust-policy and FFI allow-list CI gates
data.done_when: Both static evals of the story fail on a seeded violation and pass on main.
data.next_action: Write scripts/ci/rust-policy.sh and deny.native.toml listing rocksdb and aws-lc with owner, purpose, licence, version, review date.

data.title: Design range/Raft architecture and key layout
data.done_when: Design doc reviewed covering range descriptor, Raft library choice, placement, WAL fsync path and node/edge key encoding.
data.next_action: Draft docs/design/raft-ranges.md: compare openraft vs raft-rs, AZ placement, fsync-before-ack path; link REQ-0001, REQ-0016, REQ-0010.

data.title: Implement Raft group per range on RocksDB
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/raft/group.rs with RocksDB-backed log storage and AZ-aware placement; tag code 'reqforge: implements REQ-0001'.

data.title: Build fault-injection and Jepsen-style harness
data.done_when: Harness supports power-cut, leader-kill, partition, clock-skew nemeses and an Elle-style checker.
data.next_action: Create harness/src/nemesis.rs with partition, crash, power-cut and clock-skew; integrate the Elle checker via elle-cli.

data.title: Implement joint consensus and learner promotion
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes for 1 hour.
data.next_action: Add server/src/raft/membership.rs: learner add, lag-bounded promotion, joint-consensus voter change.

data.title: Tune elections and validate timeout config
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Add election-timeout validation (at least 10x heartbeat RTT) in server/src/raft/config.rs and run harness fault leader-kill.

data.title: Implement range split and rebalancer
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/placement/rebalancer.rs and size-based split in server/src/range/split.rs.

data.title: Design serializable transaction protocol
data.done_when: Design doc reviewed: timestamp source (TSO vs HLC), commit protocol, conflict detection, coordinator recovery.
data.next_action: Draft docs/design/transactions.md choosing TSO vs HLC with REQ-0014 Jepsen implications; record the choice as a new DEC.

data.title: Implement transaction coordinator and conflict detection
data.done_when: Story evals E1-E3 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/txn/coordinator.rs with parallel commit and crash recovery; add tests/txn.rs coordinator_crash_atomic.

data.title: Implement retry policy and conflict error code
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Define SERIALIZATION_CONFLICT in server/src/error.rs and restrict internal retry to read-set-unchanged cases in server/src/txn/retry.rs.

data.title: Implement node/edge encoding with in/out adjacency
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/graph/keys.rs ({node}/d, {node}/o/{type}/{dst}/{rank}, {node}/i/...) and write both directions in one txn.

data.title: Implement typed value codec, duplicate-key check and size limit
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/graph/value.rs (int64, decimal128, timestamp, binary, list, record) and a live-reloadable max_property_bytes setting.

data.title: Split hub-node adjacency across ranges
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Allow range splits inside a node prefix in server/src/range/split.rs; add the harness supernode scenario.

data.title: Scope GQL conformance and choose parser approach
data.done_when: docs/gql-conformance.toml lists every ISO/IEC 39075 feature with v1 status; parser approach decided.
data.next_action: Create docs/gql-conformance.toml from the ISO/IEC 39075 feature list and mark v1 scope; evaluate a hand-written vs generated parser.

data.title: Implement GQL parser, binder and planner
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/gql/parser.rs with feature-named errors for unsupported syntax; seed tests/gql_conformance.rs from the matrix.

data.title: Specify and implement client protocol
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes; spec published.
data.next_action: Decide transport (gRPC vs HTTP/2 vs binary), record it as a DEC, write docs/protocol/v1.md and server/src/protocol/.

data.title: Implement executor fast paths for id lookup and one-hop
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/gql/exec/point.rs (single-key get) and onehop.rs (single prefix scan); add the harness YCSB-to-GQL mapping.

data.title: Implement DELETE and DETACH DELETE
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/gql/exec/delete.rs checking incident edges and detaching across shards in one txn.

data.title: Implement transactional indexes and online backfill
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/index/ with in-txn maintenance, cross-shard unique check and a cancellable backfill job.

data.title: Instrument server with OpenTelemetry
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Add an opentelemetry-otlp exporter in server/src/telemetry.rs with the six REQ-0034 metrics at a 15 s interval.

data.title: Ship operational dashboards and alerts
data.done_when: Dashboards for latency, commit/fsync, aborts, leader changes; alerts for fsync p99 and leader flapping.
data.next_action: Create ops/dashboards/core.json and ops/alerts/core.yaml from the REQ-0034 metric names.

data.title: Implement envelope encryption at rest
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Enable the RocksDB encrypted env with AES-256 data keys wrapped by KMS in server/src/storage/encryption.rs; cover WAL and backups.

data.title: Implement analytics learners and query routing
data.done_when: Story evals E1-E3 pass.
data.next_action: Decide how a query is marked analytical (hint, session or endpoint) as a DEC, then implement server/src/htap/router.rs.

data.title: Build HTAP isolation benchmark
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Add harness/src/bench/htap.rs running ycsb-a alongside multi-hop analytical traversals.

data.title: Alert on analytics lag and OLTP p99 regression
data.done_when: Dashboards and alerts exist for analytics lag and OLTP p99 vs baseline.
data.next_action: Add ops/dashboards/htap.json and ops/alerts/htap.yaml using analytics_replication_lag_seconds and request latency p99.

data.title: Implement log backup and PITR restore
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/backup/log_shipper.rs (flush at most every 5 min) and the restore command in server/src/backup/restore.rs.

data.title: Provision backup storage and retention
data.done_when: Object-storage bucket with 7-day retention and KMS encryption configured in deploy manifests.
data.next_action: Add deploy/backup/ bucket config (7-day retention, KMS) and operator CRD fields for the backup target.

data.title: Implement compaction-bounded erasure and per-subject keys
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Design per-subject data keys in docs/design/erasure.md and add forced tombstone compaction in server/src/storage/compaction.rs.

data.title: Implement leader eviction and version compatibility
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Add a drain command (leader transfer before stop) in server/src/admin/drain.rs and an N/N+1 version gate in server/src/version.rs.

data.title: Build synthetic availability probe
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 run in staging.
data.next_action: Implement harness/src/probe.rs doing a read and write per minute with monthly availability reporting.

data.title: Deploy probe and SLO dashboard with error-budget alerts
data.done_when: Probe runs every minute against staging and prod; 99.99% SLO burn-rate alerts configured.
data.next_action: Add ops/slo/availability.yaml (99.99% monthly) and ops/alerts/burn-rate.yaml; schedule the probe in deploy/probe/.

data.title: Implement TLS and mTLS with aws-lc
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Wire rustls with the aws-lc-rs provider in server/src/net/tls.rs; AEAD-only suites; peer cert verification against the cluster CA.

data.title: Implement SCRAM, x.509 and OIDC authentication
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/auth/{scram.rs,x509.rs,oidc.rs}; default bind 127.0.0.1 and deny anonymous.

data.title: Implement graph-scoped RBAC
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes; docs/security/roles.md lists privileges.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/auth/rbac.rs with reader, writer, admin and clusterAdmin roles scoped per graph.

data.title: Implement audit log and exporter
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Implement server/src/audit/ with an append-only file sink, OTLP log export and value redaction.

data.title: Write SOC 2 / ISO 27001 control matrix
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Create docs/compliance/control-matrix.csv mapping SOC 2 TSC and ISO 27001 Annex A controls to REQ ids or exclusions.

data.title: Cross-compile and CI matrix for amd64/arm64
data.done_when: Story evals E1-E3 pass in CI.
data.next_action: Add .github/workflows/release.yml building x86_64 and aarch64 linux targets, plus scripts/ci/run-matrix.sh.

data.title: Design DSCoreCluster CRD and reconciliation
data.done_when: CRD schema and reconcile state machine reviewed.
data.next_action: Draft operator/docs/crd.md defining the DSCoreCluster spec (nodes, version, backup, tls) and reconcile states.

data.title: Implement operator create/scale/upgrade
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes on 3 Kubernetes versions.
data.next_action: Scaffold operator/ with kubebuilder; implement reconcile for create, scale (drain/add) and rolling upgrade.

data.title: Publish operator image and install manifests
data.done_when: Operator image published for amd64/arm64 with an install bundle per release.
data.next_action: Add operator/Makefile targets docker-buildx (amd64, arm64) and bundle; wire them into the release workflow.

data.title: Write language-neutral driver conformance suite
data.done_when: Story eval E1 runs for the Rust driver against current and previous server.
data.next_action: Create drivers/conformance/cases/*.yaml (connect, auth, gql, txn, conflict error, typed round-trip) and a runner per language.

data.title: Implement the six drivers
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes for all six languages.
data.next_action: Start with drivers/rust (shares the protocol crate), then go, python, java, js, dotnet; each must pass drivers/conformance.

data.title: Automate driver publishing to registries
data.done_when: Story eval E2 passes; the release workflow publishes all six.
data.next_action: Add drivers/Makefile publish targets for Maven Central, PyPI, Go modules, npm, NuGet and crates.io plus release workflow secrets.

data.title: Implement parallel loader with checkpoints and reject file
data.done_when: Story evals E1 and E2 pass.
data.next_action: Implement importer/src/loader.rs (batched, idempotent by element id, checkpointed) and importer/src/rejects.rs.

data.title: Implement CSV/JSONL readers and mapping spec
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes; docs/import/mapping.md published.
data.next_action: Implement importer/src/sources/{csv.rs,jsonl.rs} and document the mapping format in docs/import/mapping.md.

data.title: Implement Neo4j Cypher and GraphML readers
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Implement importer/src/sources/neo4j/{cypher.rs,graphml.rs} and the type mapping table docs/import/neo4j-types.md.

data.title: Implement Mongo BSON/Extended JSON readers and reference mapping
data.done_when: Story eval E1 passes.
data.next_action: Implement importer/src/sources/mongo/{bson.rs,extjson.rs} and reference-to-edge mapping in importer/src/mapping.rs.

impact_notes.stories: Creates 36 stories covering all 49 requirements; no existing stories change.
impact_notes.code: Registers 5 components (server, importer, operator, drivers, harness). No code exists yet; tasks name the files to create and the trace tags to add.
impact_notes.evals: Adds 57 evals covering every acceptance criterion (100% criteria coverage), including performance evals for REQ-0013/22/23/25, e2e/integration/synthetic-monitor for reliability REQ-0016..0021, and security evals for REQ-0035..0040.
risks: Eval commands reference a harness, scripts and test names that do not exist yet; they become runnable as tasks complete.
Open decisions embedded as tasks: transaction timestamp source (t_txn_design), client transport (t_protocol), analytical-query marking (t_analytics).
Drivers (40d) and the GQL engine (24d) are the largest items and likely the critical path, behind Raft (20d) and transactions (25d).

evals.name: power-loss durability and learner quorum exclusion
jepsen membership churn
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload membership --duration 1h --check single-leader,learner-promotion

evals.name: add-node rebalance under YCSB A
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- scenario add-node --workload ycsb-a --assert-balance 0.10 --within 1h --assert-zero-errors

evals.name: jepsen continuous splits
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload splits --duration 1h --check serializable

evals.name: jepsen serializability (Elle)
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload list-append --nemesis partition,crash,clock,membership,split --duration 1h --check serializable

evals.name: jepsen with internal retry
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload register --internal-retry on --duration 1h --check lost-update

evals.name: jepsen one-sided edge check
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload edges --duration 1h --check bidirectional

evals.name: typed values, duplicates, schemaless
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test graph_model -- typed_values duplicate_keys schemaless

evals.name: property size limit and live reconfiguration
protocol contract tests
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test protocol -- version_negotiation txn_control

evals.name: delete semantics across shards
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test gql_delete -- reject_connected detach_atomic

evals.name: index consistency and uniqueness
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test index -- read_your_commit unique_cross_shard cancel_build

evals.name: analytical routing and no fallback
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test htap -- routing_analytics_only no_voter_fallback

evals.name: OLTP p99 under analytics saturation
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- htap --oltp ycsb-a --analytics multihop --analytics-cpu 1.0 --assert-p99-degradation 0.10

evals.name: byte-scan after compaction and key destruction
rolling upgrade under load
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- upgrade rolling --from prev-minor --workload ycsb-a --assert-no-failed-interval --assert-p99-factor 1.5

evals.name: mixed-version transaction suite
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- upgrade mixed-version --suite txn

evals.name: secure defaults and auth mechanisms
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test security -- default_deny_loopback scram x509 oidc

evals.name: RBAC enforcement and documented roles
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test security -- rbac_graph_scope builtin_roles_documented

evals.name: plaintext marker scan and key rotation
audit coverage, latency and redaction
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test audit -- event_coverage_5s no_property_values

evals.name: OTel collector receives all metrics
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test telemetry -- otel_metrics_15s analytics_lag_units

evals.name: full suite on amd64 and arm64
cluster lifecycle on 3 K8s versions
evals.command: make -C operator e2e K8S_VERSIONS=latest3 TESTS='TestCreateReady10m TestScale3to5 TestRollingUpgrade'

evals.name: reject file and resume
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-importer --test import -- reject_file resume_no_duplicates

evals.name: Neo4j export fidelity and type mapping
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-importer --test neo4j -- cypher_export graphml_export type_mapping

evals.name: Mongo export fidelity and edge mapping
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-importer --test mongo -- bson_extjson_types reference_edges

evals.name: native allow-list
evals.command: cargo deny check && scripts/ci/ffi-allowlist.sh deny.native.toml --require owner,purpose,licence,version,reviewed
